ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, default link text — near-black with a barely-warm cast that harmonizes with the cream canvas rather than fighting it

paper.$description: Paper — Elevated card surfaces, button text on amber, icon fills — the brightest stop in the stack, used sparingly to lift content above the cream canvas

linen.$description: Linen — Card backgrounds, soft surface fill, inset panels — the warm off-white that sits one step above the page canvas

parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas, outer body background — the warm light gray that gives the entire interface its sunlit quality

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark surface fill for inverted cards, footer band, contrast blocks — darker than Ink so it reads as a deliberate charcoal panel

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary neutral action background, muted utility surfaces — sits between Ink and the canvas for low-emphasis interactive fills

honey.$description: Honey — Primary action fill for the demo and get-started buttons, key brand moments — the single saturated color in the system, reserved for decisions that move the user forward

apricot.$description: Apricot — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sans-serif-system.$description: Full type system — weight 500/700 at 76–101px with tracking as tight as -0.043em gives headlines a quiet authority without resorting to a serif; weight 400 at 16–18px handles body; the huge size range (8px → 101px) is editorial in proportion, not product-UI proportions
